thread:
alex: Heads-up: CanaryBank wants a 5-day POC. Requirements: token-streaming demo, runtime JSON schema enforcement, CRM lookup that must never see Redwood IPs, and a reserved-pilot pricing outline. Also SSO + SOC2 checks.

mira: I can put together a tiny streaming UI and a final call that validates JSON against a schema. Need to know if they prefer service-account creds or short-lived sessions for the connector.

dan: Recommend a customer-run connector in their VPC for the CRM lookup so CRM only sees their IPs. For hosted demo we can run a local proxy. If they insist on Redwood static IPs, we move to Dedicated NAT ranges (longer review).

alex: Can runtime refuse malformed JSON so we don't forward to CRM? They want a hard stop.

mira: Yes. We support runtime validation hooks. Options: block + return structured error, or auto-retry with a constrained prompt (we can demo block + 1 retry). All failures go to audit logs.

dan: KMS/keys: hosted demo -> mocked KMS/envelope enc. Dedicated -> cloud KMS. Private -> customer-managed keys/HSM (enterprise add-on). I'll note timelines.

sec-bot: Docs we can send: SAML/OIDC SSO guide, SOC2 summary, KMS integration notes, audit-log export (90d). Will drop links in the thread.

alex: Pricing ask: mira, can you draft three options (hosted trial credits, 1-month reserved pilot, 12-month commit) with token-cost estimate? Use conservative qps=5, seq=700 if customer doesn't provide numbers.

mira: Will do. Quick python snippet for the repo (stream + schema):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
# stream
for chunk in c.generate_stream(model="rwd-small-1", prompt="Lookup id=42 and respond JSON:"):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
# final validated call
resp = c.generate(model="rwd-small-1", prompt="Return JSON {\"id\":int,\"status\":string}", output_schema='{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"status":{"type":"string"}},"required":["id","status"]}', validate_schema=True)
print(resp.json)
```
alex: Good. Action items: mira repo + README for connector options; dan KMS/HSM & NAT ranges note; sec-bot attach docs; alex to propose demo times.
